definitions.ask: Should an off-clock session (lunch, the gym) count as the last Pomodoro behind the ⇥ mark?
definitions.why: The mark answers "since when has nothing been running", and an off-clock session was running

choices.label: ⇥ shows when any closed session ended, so after lunch it reads the lunch end
⇥ shows when the last worked session ended, skipping off-clock rows

definitions.ask: Update the mac pom glossary strand for the ⇥ last-end mark and the --last call?
definitions.corrects: It is a read-only consumer of `bob pomodoro --show-stale --worked`
